verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs show one official command-line entry point: an npx command that runs the open-sourced AI gateway locally with a single command. Nothing shows a fuller CLI for managing configs, keys, logs, prompts or the hosted platform. missing for 10: a documented CLI with management subcommands (configs, virtual keys, logs, budgets), CLI reference docs, agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
